_about: Digests of every legacyIdentityFixtures.ts case's plan (planDigest). Produced first by the planner at 4d10c53 (v1.188.0 + R0 + R1, the tree before R2 threaded WindowSpec and the PV terms through it), which R2 reproduced byte for byte; regenerated for v1.194.0, which stores a PV surplus at the charge leg (legEff) in every walk: 472 of the 1,104 plans moved, each in the direction legacyIdentity.test.ts pins against legacyIdentity.v1192.figures.json. legacyIdentity.test.ts requires the planner to reproduce each one. Regenerate only for a deliberate, reviewed change to overnight sizing, and say so in the commit.
_amended: v1.196.0 — regenerated for four deliberate, reviewed changes, on top of v1.194.0's charge leg; 870 of 1,104 digests moved against the v1.194.0 golden, each by exactly these fields. (1) The overnight write setpoint on the islanded-outage / disabled basis is that leg's own arm test, the pack at the window close against reserve + cushion, asked to the whole percent above the line (cost mode: the cost target where higher), no longer the whole-house walk to the next recharge: 431 plans move setpointSocPct, all on the islanded-outage basis, and with it the rationale and the expected* fields; of the charge plans 157 resilience plans write a lower reserve (median 13 points), 17 cost plans write lower (median 7 points) and 5 charge-rate-bound cost plans write higher (the cost target, not the derated arrival); none writes under min(50, its line). The legacy-pct basis, the backup leg and the mid-day leg keep the walk. (2) The reserve sentence says the envelope truncated the ask only when the ask is above 50%: no plan moves by this alone here; the 14 plans whose sub-50% ask read 'but the panel only accepts a backup reserve up to 50%' at v1.195.0 all move by (1). (3) Every refused plan carries basisBlockedBy (132 plans). (4) Every cost plan carries costSurplusPvFactor / costSurplusPvSamples (null without a de-biased surplus, 1 / 0 with one from before the PV factor; 563 plans, 237 non-null). No other field of any plan moved. Against v1.192.0 (the night-charge lane's own base) 871 moved: '2027-05-14 13:00' moved there by (2) alone, and the charge leg had already moved its ask to 46.8%, written 47%, which never read as truncated.
